ux.company.sub.en: Your story interests guide the market brief. Your catalog and reports stay within your company.
ux.company.sub.zh: 用公司的题材方向找到相关海外作品。剧库和报表仅对本公司可见。

ux.overview.sub.en: Find overseas dramas worth studying, and connect them to your next release.
ux.overview.sub.zh: 发现值得研究的海外短剧，为你的下一部作品寻找方向。

ux.profileSaved.en: Company profile saved. Your recommendations are up to date.
ux.profileSaved.zh: 公司资料已保存，相关作品已更新。

ux.filters.counter.en: Choose a platform to sort by views or saves.
ux.filters.counter.zh: 先选择一个平台，再按观看或收藏排序。

ux.scope.en: English public catalogs · viewer location unknown
ux.scope.zh: 英文公开剧库 · 观众地域未知

ux.dramas.personal.en: Examples matching your company’s story interests and the filters above.
ux.dramas.personal.zh: 根据公司题材方向与当前筛选，挑选值得参考的作品。

ux.dramas.all.en: A selection based on within-platform visibility, not a global ranking.
ux.dramas.all.zh: 按各平台内的可见度挑选参考作品，并非跨平台排行榜。

ux.storyBasis.en: Among prominent titles in the selected market filters. Your company’s interests are highlighted; titles can have several story types.
ux.storyBasis.zh: 当前市场筛选下的显著作品题材占比。高亮标记公司关注的题材；一部剧可以包含多个题材。

ux.nextStep.sub.en: Connect a title in your catalog to a useful next action.
ux.nextStep.sub.zh: 从自己的剧库出发，找到下一项具体行动。

ux.catalog.sub.en: Your titles, comparable overseas stories, and the materials you have ready.
ux.catalog.sub.zh: 在一个剧库里查看相关海外作品、已上传素材与下一步行动。

ux.noComparable.en: Add a synopsis to find story comparisons.
ux.noComparable.zh: 完善简介，以找到相似故事参考。

ux.rights.note.en: Check territory rights and episode approvals on the title before planning a release. Uploads alone do not establish release readiness.
ux.rights.note.zh: 筹备发行前，请在作品中核实地区版权和各集审批。已上传素材不代表已经具备发行条件。

ux.market.intent.en: Your target markets express intent; public catalog counters do not measure these audiences.
ux.market.intent.zh: 目标市场代表公司的发行意向，不代表公开剧库计数的观众地域。

ux.volume.note.en: Descriptive company information; not used to score recommendations.
ux.volume.note.zh: 用于描述公司规模，不参与推荐评分。

ux.counter.note.en: A counter observed on this platform’s public listing.
ux.counter.note.zh: 从该平台公开作品页面读取的计数。

ux.counter.limit.en: Counters use each platform’s own definitions. Compare within the same platform; these are not unique viewers or verified US audiences.
ux.counter.limit.zh: 各平台计数口径不同，请在同一平台内比较。这些数字不等于独立观众人数，也不代表已核实的美国观众。

ux.fullSource.en: Open full source in a new tab
ux.fullSource.zh: 在新标签页查看完整来源

ux.searchMatch.en: Matching “{q}” in titles, synopses, story types and company names
ux.searchMatch.zh: 在标题、简介、题材与公司名称中匹配“{q}”

ux.unlinked.en: Not linked to a catalog title

ux.sources.metrics.en: Definitions for the data you see

ux.sources.refresh.en: Collected on demand; see the read date below.
ux.sources.refresh.zh: 按需采集，以以下读取时间为准。

ux.sources.connection.en: Not connected. No data from this source is shown.
ux.sources.connection.zh: 尚未接入，页面不展示此来源的数据。

ux.sources.derived.en: Calculated from the published catalog and your own inputs.
ux.sources.derived.zh: 根据已发布剧库与公司填写的信息计算。

ux.sources.manual.en: Updated when you import a report or edit company information.
ux.sources.manual.zh: 导入报表或修改公司信息时更新。

ux.sourceLimits.en: Coverage is partial. Confirm details on the original source before making a release decision.
ux.sourceLimits.zh: 采集覆盖并不完整。做出发行决策前，请核实原始来源。

research.onboard.marketsHint.en: Choose your target release markets (up to 8).
research.onboard.marketsHint.zh: 选择计划发行的市场（最多 8 个）。

research.title.similarNote.en: Shared story types from platform tags and synopsis classification. Similarity does not establish that two listings are the same drama.
research.title.similarNote.zh: 根据平台标签与简介分类找到相似题材。题材相似并不表示两条记录是同一部剧。

ux.episodesUnknownTotal.zh: 已上传 {n} 集 · 总集数未记录

research.onboard.tropesHint.en: Choose 1–12 story types. You can change these later.
research.onboard.tropesHint.zh: 选择 1–12 个题材，之后可以随时修改。

ux.approvedEpisodes.en: {n} of {total} uploaded episodes have a current approved version.
ux.approvedEpisodes.zh: 已上传的 {total} 集中，{n} 集的当前版本已获批。

ux.licenseWindow.zh: 已记录授权日期（不代表地区版权）

ux.error.title.en: This page could not be loaded

ux.error.body.en: Try again, or return to the market overview. Your saved company information is unchanged.
ux.error.body.zh: 请重试，或返回市场概览。已保存的公司资料不会丢失。
